messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SmartRoute policy errors spiked for /v1/chat.generate (p95 error rate 18%). Affected customers: 3 active sessions (eu-west). Paging @asha_oncall · severity: high
asha_oncall: on it. digging into smart-route logs and fallback traces. will update in 5.
miguel_sre: quick note — I'm seeing repeated fallback loops between variants: requests try `model-x-q4_0` (quantized + no-toolcall), fail with toolcall-unavailable, then route to `model-x-fp16` in us-east which doesn't have the same context length config, then go back to eu-west. loop count ~3-5 per request.
asha_oncall: confirmed. sample trace: ```trace_id=trk_9a1; route=smart-route-eu; attempted=[model-x-q4_0@eu-west -> model-x-fp16@us-east -> model-x-q4_0@eu-west]; errors=[tool_call_not_supported, context_len_mismatch, kernel_incompat]```
priya_prodeng: That matches a bad entry in the compatibility matrix we shipped in the routing config yesterday. `model-x-q4_0` was marked as toolcall-compatible in eu-west by mistake. It actually lacks the tool-call shim after the quant compile.
tom_runtime: we pushed a config patch (reverted the matrix change) to staging but not prod. I can push a hotfix to prod to mark q4_0 as non-toolcall in eu-west which should stop the fallback to fp16.
jen_support: customer-facing: two customers reported degraded responses and higher latency for their assistants. One has a live demo running in eu-west. CS pinged them and offered degraded-mode workaround.
marta_csm: pinged customer, they want ETA for fix and whether data was exposed — they were told no. need confirmation to share with them.
asha_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) toggle smart-route policy to prefer `fp16` variants for smart-route-eu for 10m (manual override) 2) deploy routing matrix revert that marks q4_0 as non-toolcall in eu-west 3) throttle retries to 1 to collapse loops. I'll implement 1+3 now.
miguel_sre: I'll prepare the revert PR and tests. Recommend also disabling cross-region fallbacks for this policy until matrix is verified.
priya_prodeng: creating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing-configs/pull/412 — revert bad matrix entry + add unit test for toolcall/quant flags.
asha_oncall: executing override: `curl -X POST https://console.api/redwood/v1/policies/override -d '{"policy":"smart-route-eu","prefer_variant":"fp16","max_retries":1}'` — done. Observability: error rate p95 dropped to 4% within 2m, latency improved.
jen_support: updating customers: told them we applied an override and are deploying a config revert; next update in 30m.
priya_prodeng: PR merged and deployed to prod config-store. Routing controller picked up change at 12:42 UTC.
tom_runtime: restarting router pods in eu-west 3/3 with new config. Doing rolling restart to avoid extra churn.
miguel_sre: verifying traces, loops reduced to <1 per 1000 requests. No evidence of data exfil.
marta_csm: customer acknowledged; appreciated quick response.
asha_oncall: escalation notes: root cause = regression in compatibility matrix where quantized variant was incorrectly flagged as toolcall-capable; allowed smart-route to select incompatible variant causing fallbacks and region oscillation. Impact = higher latency + transient errors for a subset of eu-west sessions; approx 1200 failed requests over 15m.
priya_prodeng: follow-ups (post-incident): 1) Add CI gate to prevent toolcall flag changes without compile-time validation 2) Add telemetry that alerts when cross-variant fallbacks > 0.5% in 5m 3) Harden routing controller to rate-limit cross-region fallbacks
asha_oncall: on-call handoff: @marta_csm will continue customer comms; @priya_prodeng will own the postmortem and follow-ups; I'll wrap up on-call notes and close pager.
incident-bot: Pager cleared at 1768569330 — incident severity downgraded to informational.
priya_prodeng: filing ticket: INF-2026-487 — compatibility-matrix-regression. assigning to runtime + ml infra.
asha_oncall: thanks team, marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
